title: Read Metadata — Tier 3 (Minimal)
description: Minimal metadata for the Read tool. Only source and provenance are carried. Read is a high-frequency, low-signal tool — full metadata would bloat telemetry. Provenance tracks which session/agent issued the read for audit purposes.

notes.provenance: Only the 3 required fields are needed: session_id, caller_type, caller_name. Omit caller_chain, project_path_hash, timestamp_utc for Tier 3 to minimize payload.
